checks.pass: Corpus contains exactly 20 unique valid domains.
Inventory contains each production Website Intelligence module once.
At least 90% of required module runs complete.
At least 95% of sites return one or more completed modules.
At least 90% of completed modules return evidence.
The site-level p95 duration is at most 15000 ms.
At most 5% of module runs fail unexpectedly. Declared placeholders are unavailable, not failed.
Every result includes status, source, confidence, evidence, findings, summary, and duration.
All live thresholds pass before a pilot is recommended.

recommendation.statement: Proceed with a limited pilot after a flagged live run meets every acceptance target.
conditions: Treat reputation and screenshot results as declared evidence gaps until approved providers are configured.
Retain module-level provenance and availability states in pilot reports.
Do not use these validation metrics as a numeric business risk score.
